name: com.foreverworks/porkbun
title: Porkbun
description: Register domains and manage DNS, hosting and mail at Porkbun, with every purchase confirmed first.

environmentVariables.name: PORKBUN_API_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path of a file holding your Porkbun API key (pk1_...).

environmentVariables.name: PORKBUN_SECRET_API_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path of a file holding your Porkbun secret API key (sk1_...).

environmentVariables.name: PORKBUN_OUTBOX_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where the tools that save a file (an SSL bundle, an invoice PDF, a DNS zone export, a new mailbox's password) write it. Without it those tools answer with a configuration error; every other tool works.

environmentVariables.name: PORKBUN_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: The toolsets whose tools the server loads, separated by commas, e.g. dns,forwards. Empty loads every toolset.
